Project Coordinator, Infrastructure Delivery

Company: Sundial Civil Group
Locations: Calgary, AB / Edmonton, AB / Regina, SK
Work Model: Hybrid
Work Term: Summer 2027
Duration: 4 months
Application Deadline: 2027-01-22
Hourly Rate: $28.00 per hour

About the Role

Sundial Civil Group delivers municipal infrastructure projects across the Prairies. The
Project Coordinator will support project management activities on active job sites.

Responsibilities

- Track project schedules, budgets, and change orders
- Coordinate subcontractor documentation and site reporting
- Support project delivery reviews with the engineering team

Note: successful candidates may be assigned to any of the three offices listed above.
